description: The Rock Island Arsenal is conducting market research for potential vendors to provide Jet Fusion 3D printer, Jet Fusion 3D processing station, Jet Fusion build unit, and kit equipment IAW Attached RIPD   Interested vendors shall send a capability statement, provide their business size (Large Business, Small business, Women-owned small business, etc.), whether they are the manufacturer of the items; and if not the manufacture, the business size of the manufacturer, and the country of origin of the items.
